main_text.head: IMPERATOR CONSTANTINUS MAGNUS apud Eusebium in vita ipsius lib IV. cap. 24. ait ad Episcopos:
main_text.p: ὑμεῖς μὲν τῶν ἔξω τῆς ἐκκλησίας, ἐγὼ δ' ἢ τ' ἐκτὸς ὑπὸ θεοῦ καθε-σταμένῳ[?] ἐπίσκοπος ἂν εἴην.

p.i: Vos quidem eorum, quæ intra Ecclesiam sunt, ego autem eorum, quæ extra eam sunt, à Deo sum constitutus Epi-scopus.

page.notes: The Greek line 2 reads "ἐγὼ ... ἐκτὸς" in the scan; the exact letters after "ἐγὼ" and the dative ending "-σταμένῳ" are uncertain and are marked [?]. The Greek is copied from the scan, not from the standard text of Eusebius, which may differ. Printed hyphens kept at line breaks: "καθε-", "Epi-".
